feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: NPR world news, international art and culture, world business and financial markets, world economy, and global trends in health, science and technology. Subscribe to the World Story of the Day podcast and RSS feed.

entry.title: World leaders convene for UNGA. And, Trump says D.C. arch will be a 'military complex'
entry.summary: This week, world leaders convene for the U.N. General Assembly as war continues in Ukraine and the Gulf. And, President Trump has proposed that his arch serve as a military complex.

entry.title: Former UN Deputy Secretary General on the role of the UN in today's biggest conflicts
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with former United Nations Deputy Secretary General Mark Malloch-Brown about the relevance of the U.N.

entry.title: German chancellor stands his ground after his party loses in state elections
entry.summary: German Chancellor Freidrich Merz conceded that the night spells "disaster" for the political center, but assured the public he'd push ahead with his federal agenda of tax and welfare reforms.

entry.title: What to know as world leaders converge at the United Nations this week
entry.summary: United Nations head António Guterres returns to New York for his final U.N. General Assembly as diplomacy falters over wars in Ukraine and the Middle East, and the global body faces deep divisions.

entry.title: 18 suspects accused in the 2021 killing of Haiti's president being extradited to U.S.
entry.summary: Eighteen suspects who were arrested in the July 2021 killing of Haitian President Jovenel Moïse were being extradited to the U.S. on Sunday to face justice in Florida.

entry.title: How Russia's parliamentary election might affect the war in Ukraine
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep asks Russian foreign policy expert Hanna Notte about the results of Russia's parliamentary election and what it means for Moscow's war in Ukraine.

entry.title: Poison suspected in deaths of ten lions in game reserve in Tanzania
entry.summary: The lions were found dead inside the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, a popular wildlife reserve in Tanzania. Deaths raise concerns over wildlife poisonings in East Africa.

entry.title: Defining global leadership in AI at Trump-Xi summit
entry.summary: Former U.S. deputy national security advisor Anne Neuberger is watching for signs of competition and cooperation on artificial intelligence at President Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping's summit this week.

entry.title: Germany's Merz vows to press ahead with reforms after historic state election defeat
entry.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has faced a major electoral setback in two state elections, with his center-right party losing ground. The far-right Alternative for Germany party made significant gains.

entry.title: PHOTOS: The precarious life of fisherfolk
entry.summary: In the bustling heart of the southern Indian city of Chennai is a market that never sleeps, where residents from the poorest neighborhoods wage a battle of survival with the sea.
